content.value_statement: Low-quality screenshots can reduce trust in documentation, presentations, and social posts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to improve clarity, size, and sharpness.
actual_capabilities: Guides enhancement of screenshots and digital images.
Supports prompts for single-image and folder-level batch enhancement.
Covers upscaling, sharpening, artifact reduction, and text clarity.
Recommends preserving original files before saving enhanced versions.
Suggests output formats and platform-specific sizing needs.
limitations: It provides workflow guidance and depends on available image tools.
It cannot recover detail that is completely absent from the source image.
Batch work may require user approval before changing many files.
Results vary with source resolution, blur, compression, and file format.

use_cases.title: Prepare Documentation Screenshots
use_cases.description: Improve UI screenshots before adding them to product guides, help articles, or release notes.

use_cases.title: Polish Presentation Images
use_cases.description: Upscale and sharpen visuals so they remain clear on large screens and exported slides.

use_cases.title: Optimize Social Visuals
use_cases.description: Clean up images and request format choices for LinkedIn, Instagram, web posts, or newsletters.

prompt_templates.title: Improve One Screenshot
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the clarity of this screenshot. Preserve the original file and create an enhanced copy for documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Sharpen Blurry Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused enhancement for readable UI text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this blurry product screenshot. Prioritize text clarity, edge sharpness, and reduced compression artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for a Channel
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with a target destination.
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this image for a LinkedIn post. Improve sharpness, choose the best output format, and keep a backup copy.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Enhance a Folder
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multiple images with constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance all PNG screenshots in this folder for a release article. Keep originals, avoid overwriting files, and summarize changes made.

output_examples.input: A slightly blurry product screenshot for a help article.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports improved text clarity, sharper edges, reduced artifacts, and an enhanced copy saved beside the original.

output_examples.input: A folder of compressed PNG screenshots for a product launch post.
output: Each image is reviewed for resolution, blur, and compression artifacts.
Enhanced copies are created without replacing the source files.
A short summary lists the files improved and the recommended publishing format.

output_examples.input: A low-resolution image needed for a large presentation slide.
output_examples.output: The assistant suggests upscaling, sharpening, and checking the final image at presentation size before use.

best_practices: Provide the intended destination, such as documentation, slides, print, or social media.
Ask the assistant to preserve originals before creating enhanced copies.
Review text-heavy screenshots after enhancement to confirm readability.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite source files without a backup.
Do not request extreme upscaling when the source image lacks enough detail.
Do not use one export format for every channel without checking size and quality needs.

faq.question: Does this skill edit images directly?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant through image enhancement tasks. Actual editing depends on the image tools available in the environment.

faq.question: Can it improve screenshots for documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill focuses on screenshot clarity, text readability, sharpening, and output copies for documentation workflows.

faq.question: Can it process many images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes batch prompts for improving all images or selected file types in a folder.

faq.question: Will it preserve original images?
faq.answer: The skill recommends keeping original files as backups before saving enhanced versions.

faq.question: Which formats does it mention?
faq.answer: It mentions PNG for quality and JPG for smaller files, with format choice based on the intended use.

faq.question: Is it suitable for social media assets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide image sizing and optimization for social media posts when you name the target platform.
